collection.description: For weeks, a baby has been babbling at everyone who approaches.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: For weeks, a baby has been babbling at everyone who approaches. During an ordinary afternoon, the child suddenly says something that sounds unmistakably like a word. The nearby adults freeze and look at one another.

choices.label: Encourage the Baby to Say It Again
Tell the Other Parent or Caregiver
Write the Moment in the Family Record

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The baby repeats the word, and the caregiver laughs with delight.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The baby produces an entirely different noise and reaches for a spoon.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: They celebrate together and spend the evening listening for another word.

text_only.reason: a celebration or a happy feeling in the story; no celebration happens in the game -- story only: the file marks no effect (no new mechanics)

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The other caregiver misses the next attempt and jokingly accuses the baby of keeping secrets.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The caregiver preserves a small memory they hope to share with the child someday.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: They cannot agree on exactly what the baby said, and record both possibilities.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The child babbles happily in their arms while the village carries on around them.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The caregiver wonders whether it was truly a word, but decides the uncertainty changes nothing about their joy.
